# Vendored browser libraries

- `d3.v7.min.js` is the D3 7.9.0 UMD bundle from
  `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js`.
- SHA-256: `f2094bbf6141b359722c4fe454eb6c4b0f0e42cc10cc7af921fc158fceb86539`.
- D3 is distributed under the ISC license; its notice is preserved in
  `D3-LICENSE.txt`.

The file is committed intentionally so the visualizer works fully offline.
Refresh it after changing the pinned version with `npm run vendor:d3`.
